svg.title: Enzora: enzyme design within a finite screening budget
svg.desc: Three stages connect a starting enzyme and substrate to predicted candidates. The UMAP inset uses ten real computational candidates, not experimental observations.

text.tspan: Enzora: mutations for the next experiment
Many possible substitutions. A limited budget for prediction and wet-lab testing.
Define the property you want to improve
A ranked shortlist with traceable evidence
Keep the sequence, predictions and design decisions together
Choose mutation order and allowed sites
Rank against a fixed WT reference
Ready for the next experimental design
Computational workflow. Predicted structures and ranked candidates still require wet-lab validation.
